reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182, `.topic-map h3` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, altering light-theme lightness from 20% to 50%. By contrast, app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:321 converts the same 20% value to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
